summary: The change raises the Payments privileged-session idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, directly violating the SES-1 parametric bound (≤ 15). The exception EXC-0230 that was intended to authorise this deviation expired on 2026-10-11, one day before the 2026-10-12 review time, so it cannot cover the deviation per the EXC-1 rule that expired exceptions don't count. All change-management process obligations (ticket, independent approval, approval scope, testing, control-owner sign-off) are met, but the unauthorised parametric breach of a critical obligation requires rejection.
